figuren.name: Pharao Unfehlbar der Vorläufige

bild.cell_semantics: logical layout position only; not a safe fixed512crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: Male-read PHARAOH: broad squat ink-splat with splendidly offended upward chin, one broad lifted brow, pursed asymmetric closed toothless mouth. Compact blue-and-gold nemes and small cobra ornament, one little curved crook held beside body. No giant mantle hiding ink. Regal pomposity undercut by gooey roundness.

bild.cell_semantics: logical layout position only; not a safe fixed512crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: Female-read LOTUS PRIESTESS: tall pear-shaped ink blob, bright wide ivory eyes looking sidelong in skeptical wonder, uneven delighted grin with TWO upper teeth only. Narrow turquoise-and-gold lotus headband, compact handheld sistrum with simple gold rectangular loop and three visible crossbars. Two delicate lashes, no human hair or anatomy.

figuren.prompt_auszug: Male-read SCRIBE: narrow leaning comma-shaped blob with two different-sized bulging ivory eyes concentrating crosswise on a short papyrus roll. Tiny linen cap, reed stylus in other goo hand. Mouth pulled tight sideways with no visible teeth, absurdly meticulous worried concentration. Papyrus has only a few abstract shallow impressions, no legible text.

figuren.name: Hüterin Nachherfürimmer

bild.cell_semantics: logical layout position only; not a safe fixed512crop

figuren.prompt_auszug: Female-read FUNERARY CUSTODIAN: top-heavy hooked teardrop-shaped ink splat, one eyebrow raised, other eye slightly squinting, exasperated tender crooked open smile with a single upper tooth. Modest narrow linen headwrap, one gold hoop earring, turquoise collar detail.
